VI
WHY NOW

The next four months are when 2027 and 2028 couples go looking.

December is the second most popular month to propose, after May, and two in three couples start planning right away. The wedding fairs around Antwerp run from next Sunday to the end of February.

1 Nov 2026
Marry Me Mechelen

The fourth edition, at Salons Van Dijck from 11 to 17, free, with local suppliers only.

16 Nov 2026
Trouw & Trends tickets open

Free tickets for Brasschaat and Mechelen open that Monday.

December
Proposals

The second most popular month to propose in House of Weddings' survey. Two in three couples start planning right after.

31 Jan 2027
Het Bruidsparadijs, Merksem

A trouwbeurs from 10 to 17 whose invitation opens with "Ga jij trouwen in 2027, 2028 of zelfs nog later?"

21 Feb 2027
Trouw & Trends Brasschaat

Kasteel van Brasschaat, 11 to 17. Bliss Weddings will be there.

28 Feb 2027
Trouw & Trends Mechelen

Van der Valk Hotel, 11 to 17.

Behind it
24 Nov 2025

Salon Weddings, 95 couples since 2017, says it's stopping. A planner with 9,909 followers on Instagram is leaving the market.

12 Mar 2026

Statbel, weddings up 4.3% in Belgium and 6.7% in Flanders in 2024.

3 Jul 2026

Blossoms Together launches a planning tool for couples who'd rather not hire a planner. A site that shows the months a planner takes off their hands is the answer to it.

radioreflex.be (12 Oct 2026) and marrymemechelen.be. trendytrouwen.be fair pages. bruidsparadijs.be. House of Weddings' survey (5 June 2026). Salon Weddings on Instagram. Made in (3 July 2026). Statbel (12 March 2026). All read 26 Oct 2026.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

The launch offer

Your offer already trades a discount for the right to capture and share the celebration.

WHAT WE'D DO
Tell each first couple's year on the site as it happens, with their yes in writing, so the couples of 2028 meet a wedding planned your way.

THE NUMBER
First couples signed for 2027 and 2028

How you told Cinco Cero, a 50th birthday, from your Events page. The first couples' years get told the same way.

THE TEAM

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

Raka Mulya

Go to market architect and entrepreneur. Your contact at Astra.

Led global ebusiness data and insights at Heineken across 23 markets, and ran global go to market for Betty Blocks, the low code platform. Now runs sales and channel operations at efficy, a European CRM company. He also founded a stroopwafel brand from nothing and scaled it.

Raka on LinkedIn
Joshua van Zeelt

Founder of Astra Agency and JML Agency

Builds custom websites, software and apps from the first conversation to launch. Studied artificial intelligence at VU Amsterdam and holds an MSc in Strategic Entrepreneurship from RSM Erasmus. Spent seven years coordinating projects at Schiphol, where he helped develop an asset app that forecasts maintenance.

Joshua on LinkedIn

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

THE TEAM

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

Raka Mulya

Go to market architect and entrepreneur. Your contact at Astra.

Led global ebusiness data and insights at Heineken across 23 markets, and ran global go to market for Betty Blocks, the low code platform. Now runs sales and channel operations at efficy, a European CRM company. He also founded a stroopwafel brand from nothing and scaled it.

Joshua van Zeelt

Founder of Astra Agency and JML Agency

Builds custom websites, software and apps from the first conversation to launch. Studied artificial intelligence at VU Amsterdam and holds an MSc in Strategic Entrepreneurship from RSM Erasmus. PREPARED BY ASTRA FOR ELISE LAEVEN, OCTOBER 2026

The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days. A well-planned day: it is seamless.

TODAY

Your brand is ready. A couple can't see a wedding on the site yet.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

WHEN THEY DECIDE

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Pick the year and how far ahead couples book, and the months that have reached that point by today turn red.

IV

Three of the four tell weddings by name. The fourth started eleven months before you.

We opened four Antwerp planners a couple would compare you with, three of them in Wilrijk. Wedding Dreamworx tells nine weddings and quotes seven couples. Flowerytales tells four and publishes a price. Salon Weddings tells nineteen, and in November it announced it's stopping because bookings for 2026 stayed, in its own words, "té stil". Bliss Weddings, registered in February 2025, has one couple's words and a stand at Trouw & Trends in February.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

The next four months are when 2027 and 2028 couples go looking.

December is the second most popular month to propose, after May, and two in three couples start planning right away. The wedding fairs around Antwerp run from next Sunday to the end of February.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

PREPARED BY ASTRA FOR ELISE LAEVEN, OCTOBER 2026

The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days. A well-planned day: it is seamless.

TODAY

Your brand is ready. A couple can't see a wedding on the site yet.

We read every page of honeyitshandled.com this morning while you were editing it. II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

Another 4,390 marriages of people living in Belgium were registered abroad in 2024, 9% of Belgium's 48,589. Statbel counts weddings in embassies and consulates in Belgium in that line too. Destination weddings are on your form already.

III
WHEN THEY DECIDE

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Pick the year and how far ahead couples book, and the months that have reached that point by today turn red.

IV
WHO ELSE THEY SEE

Three of the four tell weddings by name. The fourth started eleven months before you.

We opened four Antwerp planners a couple would compare you with, three of them in Wilrijk. Wedding Dreamworx tells nine weddings and quotes seven couples. Flowerytales tells four and publishes a price. Salon Weddings tells nineteen, and in November it announced it's stopping because bookings for 2026 stayed, in its own words, "té stil". Bliss Weddings, registered in February 2025, has one couple's words and a stand at Trouw & Trends in February.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

The launch offer

Your offer already trades a discount for the right to capture and share the celebration.

WHAT WE'D DO
Tell each first couple's year on the site as it happens, with their yes in writing, so the couples of 2028 meet a wedding planned your way.

THE NUMBER
First couples signed for 2027 and 2028

THE TEAM

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

Raka Mulya

Go to market architect and entrepreneur. Your contact at Astra.

Led global ebusiness data and insights at Heineken across 23 markets, and ran global go to market for Betty Blocks, the low code platform. Now runs sales and channel operations at efficy, a European CRM company. He also founded a stroopwafel brand from nothing and scaled it.

Joshua van Zeelt

Builds custom websites, software and apps from the first conversation to launch. Studied artificial intelligence at VU Amsterdam and holds an MSc in Strategic Entrepreneurship from RSM Erasmus. Spent seven years coordinating projects at Schiphol, where he helped develop an asset app that forecasts maintenance.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

Searches that land on a wedding page

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days. A well-planned day: it is seamless.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

PREPARED BY ASTRA FOR ELISE LAEVEN, OCTOBER 2026

The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days. A well-planned day: it is seamless.

I
TODAY

Your brand is ready. A couple can't see a wedding on the site yet.

We read every page of honeyitshandled.com this morning while you were editing it. Since today the Events page tells two nights, Cinco Cero and the Pro League Awards '26, and Jan Geysen calls working with you "amazing, from the initial meeting to the end of the party". Weddings have their own page with your three ways of working and the launch offer for 2027 and 2028. What a couple planning a wedding can't find yet is one wedding, told from the first call to the final dance.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

PROVINCE OF ANTWERP

III
WHEN THEY DECIDE

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Pick the year and how far ahead couples book, and the months that have reached that point by today turn red.

IV
WHO ELSE THEY SEE

Three of the four tell weddings by name. The fourth started eleven months before you.

We opened four Antwerp planners a couple would compare you with, three of them in Wilrijk. Wedding Dreamworx tells nine weddings and quotes seven couples. Flowerytales tells four and publishes a price. Salon Weddings tells nineteen, and in November it announced it's stopping because bookings for 2026 stayed, in its own words, "té stil". Bliss Weddings, registered in February 2025, has one couple's words and a stand at Trouw & Trends in February.

What three of them have is a wedding a couple can picture. Yours arrive with the first couples. Until then, the site has to let a couple picture their own.

Each site opened 26 Oct 2026 between 12.07 and 12.23 UTC. Weddings told counts each planner's own wedding story pages. Instagram through the public embed the same day. Wedding Dreamworx's Instagram didn't load for us, so it has no bar. Registration dates from KBO.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VI
WHY NOW

The next four months are when 2027 and 2028 couples go looking.

December is the second most popular month to propose, after May, and two in three couples start planning right away. The wedding fairs around Antwerp run from next Sunday to the end of February.

1 Nov 2026
Marry Me Mechelen

The fourth edition, at Salons Van Dijck from 11 to 17, free, with local suppliers only.

16 Nov 2026
Trouw & Trends tickets open

Free tickets for Brasschaat and Mechelen open that Monday.

December
Proposals

The second most popular month to propose in House of Weddings' survey. Two in three couples start planning right after.

31 Jan 2027
Het Bruidsparadijs, Merksem

A trouwbeurs from 10 to 17 whose invitation opens with "Ga jij trouwen in 2027, 2028 of zelfs nog later?"

21 Feb 2027
Trouw & Trends Brasschaat

Kasteel van Brasschaat, 11 to 17. Bliss Weddings will be there.

Van der Valk Hotel, 11 to 17.

Behind it
24 Nov 2025

Salon Weddings, 95 couples since 2017, says it's stopping. A planner with 9,909 followers on Instagram is leaving the market.

12 Mar 2026

Statbel, weddings up 4.3% in Belgium and 6.7% in Flanders in 2024.

3 Jul 2026

Blossoms Together launches a planning tool for couples who'd rather not hire a planner. A site that shows the months a planner takes off their hands is the answer to it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

The launch offer

Your offer already trades a discount for the right to capture and share the celebration.

WHAT WE'D DO
Tell each first couple's year on the site as it happens, with their yes in writing, so the couples of 2028 meet a wedding planned your way.

THE NUMBER
First couples signed for 2027 and 2028

THE TEAM

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

Raka Mulya

Go to market architect and entrepreneur. Your contact at Astra.

Led global ebusiness data and insights at Heineken across 23 markets, and ran global go to market for Betty Blocks, the low code platform. Now runs sales and channel operations at efficy, a European CRM company. He also founded a stroopwafel brand from nothing and scaled it.

Raka on LinkedIn
Joshua van Zeelt

Founder of Astra Agency and JML Agency

Builds custom websites, software and apps from the first conversation to launch. Studied artificial intelligence at VU Amsterdam and holds an MSc in Strategic Entrepreneurship from RSM Erasmus. Spent seven years coordinating projects at Schiphol, where he helped develop an asset app that forecasts maintenance.

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

PREPARED BY ASTRA FOR ELISE LAEVEN, OCTOBER 2026

The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days. A well-planned day: it is seamless.

Your brand is ready. A couple can't see a wedding on the site yet.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

III
WHEN THEY DECIDE

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Pick the year and how far ahead couples book, and the months that have reached that point by today turn red.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days. A well-planned day: it is seamless.

TODAY

Your brand is ready. A couple can't see a wedding on the site yet.

We read every page of honeyitshandled.com this morning while you were editing it. II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

CITY OF ANTWERP
PROVINCE OF ANTWERP

10 couples is 1 in 250 weddings registered in the city of Antwerp in 2024, 2,496 in all.

Each dot is one wedding registered in 2024. Yours are the red ones.

Another 4,390 marriages of people living in Belgium were registered abroad in 2024, 9% of Belgium's 48,589. Statbel counts weddings in embassies and consulates in Belgium in that line too. Destination weddings are on your form already.

III
WHEN THEY DECIDE

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Pick the year and how far ahead couples book, and the months that have reached that point by today turn red.

IV
WHO ELSE THEY SEE

Three of the four tell weddings by name. The fourth started eleven months before you.

We opened four Antwerp planners a couple would compare you with, three of them in Wilrijk. Wedding Dreamworx tells nine weddings and quotes seven couples. Flowerytales tells four and publishes a price. Salon Weddings tells nineteen, and in November it announced it's stopping because bookings for 2026 stayed, in its own words, "té stil". Bliss Weddings, registered in February 2025, has one couple's words and a stand at Trouw & Trends in February.

Launch offer for 2027 and 2028

What three of them have is a wedding a couple can picture. Yours arrive with the first couples. Until then, the site has to let a couple picture their own.

Each site opened 26 Oct 2026 between 12.07 and 12.23 UTC. Weddings told counts each planner's own wedding story pages. Instagram through the public embed the same day. Wedding Dreamworx's Instagram didn't load for us, so it has no bar. Registration dates from KBO.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

The launch offer

Your offer already trades a discount for the right to capture and share the celebration.

WHAT WE'D DO
Tell each first couple's year on the site as it happens, with their yes in writing, so the couples of 2028 meet a wedding planned your way.

THE NUMBER
First couples signed for 2027 and 2028

THE TEAM

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

Raka Mulya

Go to market architect and entrepreneur. Your contact at Astra.

Led global ebusiness data and insights at Heineken across 23 markets, and ran global go to market for Betty Blocks, the low code platform. Now runs sales and channel operations at efficy, a European CRM company. He also founded a stroopwafel brand from nothing and scaled it.

Raka on LinkedIn
Joshua van Zeelt

Founder of Astra Agency and JML Agency

Builds custom websites, software and apps from the first conversation to launch. Studied artificial intelligence at VU Amsterdam and holds an MSc in Strategic Entrepreneurship from RSM Erasmus. Spent seven years coordinating projects at Schiphol, where he helped develop an asset app that forecasts maintenance.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

Letters that answer Event

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PREPARED BY ASTRA FOR ELISE LAEVEN, OCTOBER 2026

The couples marrying in 2027 are choosing their planner now.

You need a handful of them. The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024. This plan is what those couples compare before they write to anyone, when they decide, the site we've sketched so they can see a wedding planned your way, and what we'd do in the first 90 days. A well-planned day: it is seamless.

I
TODAY

Your brand is ready. A couple can't see a wedding on the site yet.

We read every page of honeyitshandled.com this morning while you were editing it. Since today the Events page tells two nights, Cinco Cero and the Pro League Awards '26, and Jan Geysen calls working with you "amazing, from the initial meeting to the end of the party". Weddings have their own page with your three ways of working and the launch offer for 2027 and 2028. What a couple planning a wedding can't find yet is one wedding, told from the first call to the final dance.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

20 couples is 1 in 396 weddings registered in the province of Antwerp in 2024, 7,919 in all.

Each dot is one wedding registered in 2024. Yours are the red ones.

Another 4,390 marriages of people living in Belgium were registered abroad in 2024, 9% of Belgium's 48,589. Statbel counts weddings in embassies and consulates in Belgium in that line too. Destination weddings are on your form already.

III
WHEN THEY DECIDE

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Pick the year and how far ahead couples book, and the months that have reached that point by today turn red.

IV
WHO ELSE THEY SEE

Three of the four tell weddings by name. The fourth started eleven months before you.

We opened four Antwerp planners a couple would compare you with, three of them in Wilrijk. Wedding Dreamworx tells nine weddings and quotes seven couples. Flowerytales tells four and publishes a price. Salon Weddings tells nineteen, and in November it announced it's stopping because bookings for 2026 stayed, in its own words, "té stil". Bliss Weddings, registered in February 2025, has one couple's words and a stand at Trouw & Trends in February.

What three of them have is a wedding a couple can picture. Yours arrive with the first couples. Until then, the site has to let a couple picture their own.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

The next four months are when 2027 and 2028 couples go looking.

December is the second most popular month to propose, after May, and two in three couples start planning right away. The wedding fairs around Antwerp run from next Sunday to the end of February.

The second most popular month to propose in House of Weddings' survey. Two in three couples start planning right after.

3 Jul 2026

Blossoms Together launches a planning tool for couples who'd rather not hire a planner. A site that shows the months a planner takes off their hands is the answer to it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

PLACEHOLDER

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

The launch offer

Your offer already trades a discount for the right to capture and share the celebration.

WHAT WE'D DO
Tell each first couple's year on the site as it happens, with their yes in writing, so the couples of 2028 meet a wedding planned your way.

THE TEAM

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

Raka Mulya

Go to market architect and entrepreneur. Your contact at Astra.

Led global ebusiness data and insights at Heineken across 23 markets, and ran global go to market for Betty Blocks, the low code platform. Now runs sales and channel operations at efficy, a European CRM company. He also founded a stroopwafel brand from nothing and scaled it.

Raka on LinkedIn
Joshua van Zeelt

Founder of Astra Agency and JML Agency

Builds custom websites, software and apps from the first conversation to launch. Studied artificial intelligence at VU Amsterdam and holds an MSc in Strategic Entrepreneurship from RSM Erasmus. Spent seven years coordinating projects at Schiphol, where he helped develop an asset app that forecasts maintenance.

II
THE MARKET

The province of Antwerp registered 7,919 weddings in 2024, the most in ten years.

Flanders registered 27,147, up 6.7% on 2023, and the city of Antwerp 2,496. You don't need a big share of that. A planner who takes ten couples a year, which is Flowerytales' own ceiling, needs one wedding in 792 in the province. Change the place and the number of couples and watch your share.

WHEN THEY DECIDE

Nine in ten 2027 weddings are already inside the year Wedding Dreamworx asks for.

Wedding Dreamworx asks couples for at least a year and would rather have eighteen months. Blossoms Together's planning timeline starts eighteen months out. In House of Weddings' 2025 survey, couples planning now expect to be engaged for 17.7 months, and two in three start planning the moment they're engaged. Launch offer for 2027 and 2028

What three of them have is a wedding a couple can picture. Yours arrive with the first couples. Until then, the site has to let a couple picture their own.

Each site opened 26 Oct 2026 between 12.07 and 12.23 UTC. Weddings told counts each planner's own wedding story pages. Instagram through the public embed the same day. Wedding Dreamworx's Instagram didn't load for us, so it has no bar. Registration dates from KBO.

V
THE MONEY

Couples planning now expect to spend about €31,750. A planner in Flanders starts at €350 and runs to five figures.

That's the average from House of Weddings' 2025 survey for engaged couples, up from €21,339 in 2022. Wedding Dreamworx tells couples to count on about 15% of the budget for planning. Flowerytales starts at €5,950 excl. VAT for planning and styling. Bring us a dream starts at €350 on mariages.net. You don't publish a price, and this plan doesn't set one. Move the budget and see what Wedding Dreamworx's rule of thumb makes of it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

The screens of the new site arrive here once it's live. Until then this chapter is a placeholder with no screenshots in it.

VIII
THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Event

Referrals

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

WHAT WE'D DO
Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.

THE NUMBER
Letters that answer Referral

Astra, one team with Amwisesa.

Astra plans and builds websites, apps and the systems around them. Astra and Amwisesa work as one team, Astra on strategy and project management, Amwisesa building.

The team has built for Unilever, Pertamina, the World Bank, Nestlé, IKEA, Panasonic, AXA, AIA, Bank Mandiri and Telkom.

Built by Amwisesa, Astra's development partner, often through the brand's own agency.

Raka Mulya

Go to market architect and entrepreneur. Your contact at Astra.

Led global ebusiness data and insights at Heineken across 23 markets, and ran global go to market for Betty Blocks, the low code platform. Now runs sales and channel operations at efficy, a European CRM company. He also founded a stroopwafel brand from nothing and scaled it.

VII
THE NEW SITE

The site we sketched lets a couple see their own year with you.

It opens on one question, "When's your I do?" The couple gives their date and the page counts back from it in your three colours, something off white, something blue, something red, month by month to the final dance, in your words and your pictures. One wedding is built down the page, the date, the place, the guests and the kind of help, and it arrives at the end as a letter in your red envelope, already filled in.

THE FIRST COUPLES

Six ways the first couples find you, all ending on the same letter.

Your form already asks how people found you. These are the answers it offers, plus the launch offer itself, which is the one channel nobody else in Antwerp has this year.

Instagram

56% of the couples in House of Weddings' survey look for ideas there, and it's the first answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Post the couple's year one month at a time, straight from the new site, and keep telling nights the way you told Cinco Cero, a sign, a setting, a night.

THE NUMBER
Visits from Instagram that reach the letter

Pinterest

65.3% of the same couples use it, more than any other source. Your home page already speaks it, "a Pinterest board with 847 pins".

WHAT WE'D DO
Make a board for every page of the new site and every event, each pin linking back to the date question.

THE NUMBER
Saves and clicks to the site

Google

The second answer on your form.

WHAT WE'D DO
Give weddings in Antwerp and destination weddings a page each, and put Jan's words where couples check before they write.

THE NUMBER
Searches that land on a wedding page

Fairs and House of Weddings

House of Weddings, used by 65% of the couples it surveyed, lists only planners with its label. Newcomers get in when label partners they've worked with vouch for them and their online reviews are good.

WHAT WE'D DO
Walk Marry Me Mechelen this Sunday and Het Bruidsparadijs in January, decide on a stand for Trouw & Trends, and ask the suppliers you work with about the label.

Letters that answer Event

125 guests saw Cinco Cero and 570+ the Pro League Awards. Bliss Weddings' only quote is from a couple who'd seen Lissa work at a family wedding.

Put a card in your red envelope for every guest list you handle, with the date question on it.
